theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (x : Eucl P) (ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → (∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n)) → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) * ‖ξ y - ξ x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ y in M, θ y * (ξ y - ξ x) ((r ^ n)⁻¹ • ω (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
